parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kettle, typically made of stainless steel or similar heat-resistant material. It covers the top opening of the kettle.
parts.Functional_description: The lid prevents heat and steam from escaping and helps water boil faster. It can be removed for filling or cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the kettle, made of heat-resistant Bakelite or plastic to allow safe handling.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and pour the kettle safely without touching the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kettle, made of stainless steel, which holds the water and withstands high temperatures.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the container for heating water and includes the spout for pouring.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except when the entire kettle is lifted for pouring.
